items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, now day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team wants to see how he feels this week before determining Sunday availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib/chest injury after big hit; imaging pending
items.implication: Risk of missing or limited Week 2; monitor practice
items.opportunity: Increased role for Tre Harris, Derius Davis, Quentin Johnston if out

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, would likely have returned if playoff game. MRI upcoming; coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated but not serious per sources
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or close; backup plans needed
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman viable add; Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist fracture) multi-week out boosts others

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, 21 routes, 7/7 targets) but got only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy; great vs CLE next.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with TD upside; continue as lead

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but two almost-plays; 92% route participation. Want all the Loveland, buying low where possible.
items.why: Elite route share despite poor production; near-misses
items.implication: Strong hold/buy; TE upside with volume

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak now considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week's meniscus trim; working hard to return, possible Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.implication: Could return sooner than expected; Mayer temporary fill-in
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated role if delayed

items.text: Travis Etienne did not fully dominate with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/Etienne, 26/Miller, 15/Donaldson; routes 24/7/5; opps 18/9/4. Surprised by committee.
items.why: Kamara inactive; Etienne lead but not dominate
items.implication: Etienne still lead but handcuff Miller relevant; concern for full takeover
items.opportunity: Kendre Miller/Devin Neal/Donaldson upside if continues

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets team-high 31% share, 6-69-0; emerged healthy. Late game-time decision to play.
items.why: Cleared late; high route/target share despite limited snaps
items.implication: WR1 trajectory as snaps ramp; start confidently
items.opportunity: Fuller role upcoming with Jaxson Dart efficient

items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries watching: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), Chig Okonkwo (hamstring), Dylan Sampson (knee), Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist), Omar Cooper (ankle). Plus Bowers/AJ Brown etc.
items.implication: Monitor all for Week 2; beneficiaries emerge

items.text: Risk-reward because maybe decoy but starting Malik Nabers wherever owned after active.
Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, no WR3 targets, no TE2 usage.
items.implication: Lock in the four; fade others hard

items.text: Week 1 recap: Concern for Loveland/LAC offense/Fannin/London-Pitts/Etienne. Watson, Likely, Monty & Coke Heads time is now.
Dalton Kincaid appears over PCL: 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Allen dropbacks (69%). Will move needle when on field.
items.opportunity: High route rate in Bills offense

items.text: Ja'Kobi Lane wrist injury longer-term (fractured); multi-game absence expected. Flowers DTD by comparison.
items.implication: Stash or drop depending depth; Bateman/others rise

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
